messages:
jess: FYI canary rollout v3.7.0 started ~3412109400 and we see p95 jump on text-gen path. p95 went from ~180ms -> ~520ms, p99 -> ~1.6s. Affected model: redwood-vicuna-13b-quant on canary pool us-west-2-canary-1. Link to canary dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/canary/3412109876

sre-bot: Alert created: INCIDENT-2026-0234. Canary p95/p99 spike detected on runtime v3.7.0.

support-bot: Related support ticket #4532 opened by AcmeCorp reporting increased tail latency starting ~14:12 UTC. They included request ids: rq_8a3f...rj_9f0b.

mike: Can we confirm this is runtime-level (kernel/allocator) not model/embedding? Any recent kernel selector or batching changes in this rollout?

jess: Yes — change list for v3.7.0: kernel-selector=auto-v2, default_batch_window_ms 20 -> 35, kvcache-allocator switch to arena-alloc (replacing jemalloc shim). Suspect either larger batching window or allocator.

olivia: I pulled a few raw p99 traces from canary:
```
2026-03-17T14:15:21.123Z request_id=rq_8a3f latency_total=1620ms p99_token_latency=380ms kernel=matmul_v2 allocator=arena-alloc batch_size=1
2026-03-17T14:15:22.204Z request_id=rq_9b4c latency_total=1542ms p99_token_latency=410ms kernel=matmul_v2 allocator=arena-alloc batch_size=2
```

chao: Interesting that batch_size is tiny but token latency still high. If batch_window increased we'd expect bigger batches. Suggest we run a controlled canary-bisect: disable kernel-selector auto-v2 and force kernel=matmul_v1, then retest; also try swapping allocator back to jemalloc shim.

mike: Agreed. Plan: 1) repro locally with our loadtester using the exact canary runtime image, 2) run three variants in canary: (A) current rollout, (B) force kernel matmul_v1, (C) allocator=jemalloc shim, 3) collect p95/p99 and kernel traces. Who can execute?

jess: I can run local repro and a canary patch. Repro command I'm using:
```
runtimetest --image=redwood/runtime:v3.7.0 --model=redwood-vicuna-13b-quant --seq=512 --qps=80 --concurrency=16 --duration=5m
```

jess: Local repro shows same pattern: p95 ~480ms p99 ~1.5s. Attaching a minimal curl payload that triggers the slow path (long prefix + streaming):
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-vicuna-13b-quant","input":"<long prompt...>","max_tokens":512,"stream":false}'
```

mike: Good repro. Chao — can you prepare two small canary patches: one with `--kernelselector=matmul_v1` and one with `--allocator=jemalloc-shim`? We'll deploy each to 1/4 of the canary pool and compare. If either fixes tail, we can roll forward a hotpatch.

chao: On it. Also enabling verbose kernel-selection logs: `RUNTIME_DEBUG=kernel:trace` for the experiment. Will push patches now.

sre-bot: Canary rollout patch A (kernelselector=matmul_v1) deployed to us-west-2-canary-1 subset at 3412109805. Patch B (allocator=jemalloc-shim) deployed to us-west-2-canary-2 subset at 3412109850.

olivia: Early numbers (5m window):
- baseline (v3.7.0 auto): p95=520ms p99=1620ms
- patch A (matmul_v1): p95=190ms p99=420ms
- patch B (jemalloc-shim): p95=210ms p99=480ms
Patch A looks like the clear win.

mike: Nice. That strongly implicates kernel-selector change. Any increased error rate or regressions with matmul_v1?

olivia: No error uptick. CPU/GPU utilization similar. Matmul_v1 shows slightly higher throughput for small batches.

jess: Given data, propose hotpatch: set `--kernelselector=matmul_v1` for rollout and cut back kernel-selector auto-v2 until we investigate kernel performance on longer sequences and quantized kernels. I'll open PR to revert kernel-selector default and prepare hotpatch rollout plan.

chao: I'll start a bisect run to identify the exact commit in kernel-selector that introduced regression, comparing matmul_v1 vs auto-v2 variants across sequence lengths (64/256/512).

mike: Good. Support follow-up: @support-bot can you notify AcmeCorp that we identified the root cause (kernel-selector change) and we're rolling a hotpatch to reduce tail latency? Provide ETA ~30m for canary update and ~2h for full rollout if stable.

support-bot: Message queued to ticket #4532: "We traced increased tail latency to a kernel-selection change in runtime v3.7.0. We're hotpatching canary to matmul_v1 now; expected mitigation in ~30m. Will update with results." :thumbsup:

jess: After hotpatch stabilizes we'll run a longer stress (2h) with streaming enabled and run pprof on token loop to find regression vector. Also add regression test in CI that compares p95/p99 against baseline for a small synthetic workload so this doesn't slip next time.

mike: Thanks everyone. Next steps: (jess) open revert PR + hotpatch rollout, (chao) bisect & kernel microbench, (olivia) monitor canary dashboards and collect traces, (support-bot) update customer. Keep thread updated. :white_check_mark:
